name: Gryphoceratops
sum: Gryphoceratops is a tiny leptoceratopsid from the Santonian Milk River Formation of Alberta, known from a single jaw.
wsnote: Probably the smallest adult ceratopsian known from North America (cited Wikipedia revision); no length given.
holotype: ROM 56635, a partial right dentary — bonebed 55, Milk River Formation, Dinosaur Provincial Park, Alberta.
biology: Known from one jaw; no behavioural data.
author: Ryan et al. 2012

sources.text: Ryan, Michael J.; Evans, David C.; Currie, Philip J.; Brown, Caleb M.; Brinkman, Don 2012. New leptoceratopsids from the Upper Cretaceous of Alberta, Canada. Cretaceous Research 35: 69–80. doi:10.1016/j.cretres.2011.11.018
